purpose: Verify a GCP execution of the unified src.causal_forest_runner reproduces a bounded local reference before GCP is trusted for the 500K seed-robustness runs or the single authorized FULL-scale fit. This is a parity check on the runner/environment, never a second real seed-robustness leg and never a source of held-out evidence.

population.population_note: <=50,000 TRAIN rows -- small enough that the exact sorted subset ids can be transferred verbatim in the reference bundle (round 2 correction's 'no Python set of millions of ids' concern does not apply at this bounded scale; the runner itself still draws the subset via the same stratified mechanism as any other stage, it is simply reproducible from a small, explicit id list rather than re-derived).
population.validation_scope: The parity check scores the SAME bounded 50,000-row TRAIN-derived model against a fixed, explicitly-listed VALIDATION id subset (not the complete 2,096,938-row VALIDATION population) -- this is a runner/environment parity check, not a statistical evidence run, so scoring the complete validation cohort is unnecessary cost.

frozen_config.config_hash_must_match: The local reference run's config_hash (recorded in its audit/run_config.json and checkpoint 001) must equal the GCP run's config_hash exactly. Any mismatch stops the parity check before predictions are even compared.

hard_match.rule: Every field must be identical string-for-string between the local reference and the GCP execution. A mismatch on any hard_match field is a STOP -- fix the GCP environment (pin the same versions) before re-attempting parity, never loosen this contract to accommodate a drifted environment.
hard_match.econml_pin: 0.17.0 (src.causal_forest_baseline.FROZEN_ECONML_VERSION) -- modeling_environment() itself raises CausalForestRunnerError if the installed econml does not match this pin, on either machine.

recorded_not_gated.rule: Captured for the record on both machines and reported side by side. Differences here (OS, CPU architecture, BLAS/OpenMP backend) are expected between a local workstation and a GCP instance and never block parity by themselves.

local_reference_transfer.problem: outputs/runs/ is git-ignored, so the local reference evidence cannot reach a GCP session via the git remote -- it must move through an out-of-band channel (e.g. a manually-uploaded bundle to the GCP instance/bucket), which is an operational step outside this repository, not a repo file.

bundle_contents.run_identity: run_id, stage='gcp_parity', population_size, sampling_seed, model_seed, config_hash, dataset_sha256
bundle_contents.train_subset_ids: the exact sorted _source_row_id list drawn locally by _stratified_train_subset_ids (population_size<=50000 makes verbatim transfer reasonable) -- GCP does NOT re-derive this subset from a re-run of the stratified draw; it is given the exact ids so any predict-side discrepancy cannot be blamed on a different training subset
bundle_contents.validation_subset_ids: the exact sorted _source_row_id list the parity check scores, same rationale
bundle_contents.reference_predictions: predictions/validation_tau.parquet from the local reference run -- [_source_row_id, tau] for validation_subset_ids only
bundle_contents.reference_diagnostic_summary: audit/diagnostic_support_summary.json from the local reference run
bundle_contents.reference_environment: audit/environment fields captured via modeling_environment() on the local machine

local_reference_transfer.explicitly_excluded: models/causal_forest.pkl (the local serialized model itself) is NEVER required or transferred. GCP must independently fit its own model from the transferred config/ids/data selector and reproduce predictions -- parity is proven by matching outputs from matching inputs, not by reusing the local model artifact.

hard: config_hash identical between local reference and GCP execution
GCP checkpoint chain (001-004) completes with no unresolved exception
GCP diagnostic_support_summary alpha_all_finite/jac_all_finite/tau_all_finite all True (same hard correctness bar as every other stage)
max absolute difference between GCP tau predictions and the transferred reference tau predictions, on the shared validation_subset_ids, is <= 1e-6
diagnostic_only_never_gating: exact bit-identity of predictions beyond the 1e-6 tolerance (recorded as a bonus signal, not required -- cross-platform floating-point rounding, e.g. differing FMA/instruction-set behavior under identical n_jobs=1, is tolerated within the numeric bound above)

fail_disposition.config_hash_or_hard_match_mismatch: STOP before comparing any predictions. Fix the GCP environment/config to match the local reference and re-attempt; this is an environment-provisioning defect, not a modeling finding.
fail_disposition.predictions_exceed_tolerance_with_matchi: STOP GCP promotion pending root-cause (platform-numerics investigation). Does not invalidate or require rerunning the local reference itself.
fail_disposition.classification: Both failure modes above are 'genuine implementation/infrastructure defect' under the T11 failure taxonomy (configs/t11_causal_forest_full.json#failure_taxonomy) -- neither is reported as algorithmic seed instability, and neither authorizes silently loosening this contract.

lifecycle_state_evidence.note: Contract only. No GCP execution, no local reference run, and no bundle transfer has occurred under this config.
